levels.title: First Sweep
levels.challenge: First drag: collect two orange Sproutlings, then move the green tray up.
levels.blockerIntent: Foreign-color Sproutlings stay mostly out of the way; learn the base interaction first.

levels.title: Bent Paths
levels.challenge: Bent footprints need clearance; two short routes share the middle.
levels.blockerIntent: A Sproutling of the other color sits on the convenient line, teaching that other colors are solid.

levels.title: Three at Once
levels.challenge: Three color clusters must be collected together on a larger board.
levels.blockerIntent: Three colors create the first soft obstacle field without making the board cramped.

levels.title: Busy Middle
levels.challenge: Four different trays meet around a busy central crossing.
levels.blockerIntent: Four color fields shape shared maneuvering space around the center.

levels.title: Outside Loop
levels.challenge: Two purple trays with different footprints divide the outside loop.
levels.blockerIntent: A central green Sproutling cluster makes the perimeter attractive for the long purple Habitat.

levels.title: Cross Traffic
levels.challenge: Two differently shaped red trays choose crossing routes through traffic.
levels.blockerIntent: Opposing target fields make the shared center a contested route.

levels.title: First Lift
levels.challenge: Four trays share a broad funnel; the single lift remains the first arrival lesson.

levels.title: Open Practice
levels.challenge: Two regions hold paired yellow and purple trays; assists stay optional.

levels.title: Two Arrivals
levels.challenge: Five trays choose how to use two arrivals and the shared middle.

levels.title: Cross Queue
levels.challenge: Paired red and cyan trays negotiate crossed arrival queues.

levels.title: Tight Schedule
levels.challenge: First Hard tier: known rules only, deeper queue/space ordering.

levels.title: Four-Way Supply
levels.challenge: Second optional assistance unlock metadata only. Four Elevator directions; booster-free solvability remains mandatory.

levels.title: Quiet Junction
levels.challenge: Consolidation: no new mechanic, just queue timing and route planning.

levels.title: Event Ready
levels.challenge: Campaign board reserved for future optional event overlay; no BonusPickup is required in M6.

levels.title: Guide Grooves
levels.challenge: Two horizontal and two vertical trays cross around a forgiving central pocket.

levels.title: Guided Arrival
levels.challenge: Four guided lanes and one free yellow tray coordinate two arrival queues.

levels.title: Crossed Deliveries
levels.challenge: Hard combination: constrained routes plus authored multi-colour Elevator timing.

levels.title: Mastery Exchange
levels.challenge: Green has a dedicated vertical lift lane; five trays time four deliveries through shared pockets.

levels.title: Level 19
levels.challenge: 11 habitats, 25 sproutlings, 2 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 20
levels.challenge: 10 habitats, 16 sproutlings, 2 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 21
levels.challenge: 8 habitats, 7 sproutlings, 4 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 22
levels.challenge: 11 habitats, 19 sproutlings, 2 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 23
levels.challenge: 10 habitats, 23 sproutlings, 1 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 24
levels.challenge: 9 habitats, 22 sproutlings, 1 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 25
levels.challenge: 11 habitats, 24 sproutlings, 0 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 26
levels.challenge: 9 habitats, 18 sproutlings, 2 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 27
levels.challenge: 12 habitats, 18 sproutlings, 2 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 28
levels.challenge: 11 habitats, 19 sproutlings, 3 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 29
levels.challenge: 9 habitats, 16 sproutlings, 2 elevator queues.

levels.title: Level 30
levels.challenge: 8 habitats, 20 sproutlings, 0 elevator queues.

levels.title: Interlock Garden
levels.challenge: Open the center, trade space around the paired rings, then clear both queues.

levels.title: Pocket Exchange
levels.challenge: Clear independent pocket trays into their local target bays. The centre column is a permanent recovery lane; dual trays cross it only after their first stage.

levels.title: Offset Relay
levels.challenge: Resolve staggered target bays, then move each dual relay through its offset buffer to collect the released second-stage sproutling.

levels.title: Forked Exchange
levels.challenge: Choose either fork branch first. Both reconverge at the shared pocket; the order changes efficiency but preserves recovery.

levels.title: Hub Loop Stage Relay
levels.challenge: Open the hub, relay a stage through the lower loop, use its elevator release, then enter the newly available pocket.
